2014_spells.whirlwind.effectSummary: Deal 10d6 bludgeoning damage to a target within 300 ft
2014_spells.whirlwind.fullDescription: Using 1 action, a whirlwind howls down to a point on the ground you can see within range. A creature takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; When a creature starts its turn restrained by the whirlwind, the creature is pulled 5 feet higher inside the whirlwind, unless the creature is at the top. Until the spell ends, you can use your action to move the whirlwind up to 30 feet in any direction along the ground; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
